Name of the Surah

• It is called al-Qari'ah (The Striking Calamity), because it opens with mention of al-Qari'ah, which is one of the names of the Day of Resurrection.

Aims of the Surah

• It speaks of the Resurrection and the terrors and conditions that will occur in it, of what will be the cause of a person's happiness, namely a pleasing life in Paradise, and of what will be the cause of his misery, namely a destination in the Fire of Hell.

[Tafsir]

The Hour that strikes the hearts of people with its terrors.
And what could make you know what it is?
On that day, people will be in their multitude, their scattering and their agitation like scattered moths, which fall into the fire.
And the mountains will be like wool of many colors that is carded by hand, so it becomes dust scattered in the air and disappears.
